paragraphs: From Mullingar, begin on Bellview Heights, moving off to the right and continuing as the road bends left
Take the 1st right onto Glenview Heights and drive to the end for a short stop
Pull away again on Glenview Heights, perform a controlled U-turn when it is safe
Continue as the road bends left the road changes name to Meadow Court, so carry straight on
At the end of the road turn right onto the Dublin Road and follow it for a good stretch
Take the next right, still on the Dublin Road
Turn left into Ginnell Terrace follow Ginnell Terrace with a left and then a right, and pull in for a short stop
Move off again on Ginnell Terrace, bearing right and then slight right as the road opens up
Turn right onto Mullingar North Urban ED take the next right onto Austin Friars Street
Continue straight ahead as the road becomes Pearse Street, then Oliver Plunkett Street
Bear slight left onto Dominick Street turn right off Dominick Street, and at the roundabout take the U-turn exit to head back the way you came
Pull in briefly, then move off and turn left back onto Dominick Street
Continue straight through as the name changes to Oliver Plunkett Street, Pearse Street, and Austin Friars Street
Pull away again on Austin Friars Street, continue straight as it becomes the Dublin Road
Turn left onto Mullingar North Urban ED go straight onto Bellview Heights, pull in on the right, then move off once more
Follow Bellview Heights as it bends left take the 1st right onto Glenview Heights, and continue as the road bends right into Meadow Court
At the end of the road turn right onto the Dublin Road and continue straight as it becomes Austin Friars Street
Turn right onto Castle Street, then carry straight ahead as it becomes Harbour Street and then Harbour Road
Take the next right, still on Harbour Road, and pull in on the right to finish the route as you head back toward the Mullingar test centre area
